meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of claims the Board assembled, not claims accepted or paid, and a share with an attorney says how often workers were represented, not whether they needed to be. Questions about a workers' compensation claim are for a licensed New York attorney or the Board.

changes.title: Version 2.0.0
changes.summary: Record texts and descriptions state only published figures. Record-specific columns moved from ny-workers-comp.csv to ny-workers-comp-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; every figure is unchanged.

changes.title: New York workers' compensation claims by county first published
changes.summary: Assembled workers' compensation claims in every New York county for accident years 2000 to 2026, with the share represented by an attorney, controverted claims, hearings and permanent disability classifications: 5,655,563 claims in the Board's file.
